snippet.title: Unused Early HNR Alpha 1 Intro
snippet.description: this was the original planned intro for HNR Alpha 1 a long time ago before much development took place. it starts off similarly to the final intro used but it's different in many ways. this intro was never completely finished, hence why the ending feels a bit rough. despite being made long before the first internal build of hnr alpha 1 was ever packaged, i recorded this video a few days ago in the most recent version of hnr at the time (that being 1.1), so that's why everything looks the same as it does now.
